questions.q: Which system is the system of record for quotations, invoices and real margin?
questions.e: Intact owns money and documents. The CRM owns relationships and control; the mailbox carries information between them.

questions.q: Which field tells you who really owns an account?
questions.e: Sales Rep is the single field that decides whose book, whose pipeline and whose pulse email an account belongs to.

questions.q: Where does an order live once it is placed?
questions.e: Intact is the system of record for orders, stock and invoicing. The CRM holds the pursuit; quoteRef and accountCode are how the two tie together.

questions.q: Which field is the ownership field on a company record in our CRM?
questions.e: Sales Rep is the truth everywhere. The older Account Owner column was hidden from views and record pages because it read as Stephen on everything and misled people.

questions.q: Why is the built-in Account Owner field hidden on our record pages?
o: It reads as Stephen on nearly everything, so it is misleading
It was replaced by the Case owner field
It is only visible to administrators
questions.e: It was deliberately hidden during the 1 July 2026 view overhaul so nobody derives ownership from it. Sales Rep is the truth.

questions.q: Which two views should read zero every morning?
o: All Open (SLA) and Resolved — Last 30 Days
Open cases (by status) and the Command Centre
questions.e: Unowned cases means somebody has to claim it; Overdue cases means it has to be cleared or escalated. When both read zero, the queue is under control.

questions.q: Why is there no versus-target gauge on the dashboard?
o: The widget type is not supported
The Sales Target and Sales Transaction objects are empty
It was removed for being a vanity metric
questions.e: Both objects exist but hold no data, so there is nothing to compare against. Seeding targets is what would unlock a versus-target gauge and a pipeline coverage ratio.

questions.q: How quickly must an inbound customer item be acknowledged?
o: Within 1 working hour, or 15 minutes if it is Urgent
Before the end of the week
questions.e: The standard acknowledgement SLA is 1 working hour. Urgent items — site down, deadline today, key account at risk — drop that to 15 minutes.

questions.scenario: In a management meeting someone asks to see how the team is tracking against this month's sales target inside the CRM.
o: Open the versus-target gauge on the Command Centre
Explain that the Sales Target object is empty, so there is no target gauge or coverage ratio yet - targets would need to be loaded first
Export the opportunities and calculate it manually as if it were a CRM report
Use weighted pipeline as the target
questions.e: The Sales Target and Sales Transaction objects both exist but hold no data, so the CRM cannot show progress against a target or a coverage ratio. Say so plainly rather than substituting a number that means something else.
